700 tests, 698 pass, 2 fail. Both in `auth/tokens.test.js`:

- `refreshToken silently accepts an already-revoked token` — auth/tokens.test.js:400
- `sessionCleanup leaves orphaned rows after a rollback` — auth/tokens.test.js:650

Rest of log is uniform `ok N - test_N passed`, nothing else abnormal. No summary footer at end of file — log stops at test 699.

Both failures same file, both real-looking bugs not flakes: first one auth bypass (revoked token still refreshes), second leaks session rows on rollback. First is security-grade — prioritize.
